name: Liquid-hydrogen polymer-composite cyclic fatigue at 20 K
plain_name: Liquid-hydrogen polymer-composite cyclic fatigue at 20 K
description: Characterize fatigue damage under repeated mechanical loading of a polymer composite in the 20 K liquid-hydrogen environment documented for CRAFT.

sources.citation: Washington State University HYPER, CRyogenic Accelerated Fatigue Testing

requirements.rationale: The documented liquid-hydrogen test-bath point is 20 K; cold reach alone cannot satisfy specimen operation at that point.
The selected exposure is actual liquid hydrogen, beyond a helium-cooled coupon.

missing_information: Frequency, load ratio, cycle count, coupon geometry and measured fatigue life are protocol-specific and not synthesized from the frame's 100 Hz maximum.
confirmation_note: Curated bounded procedure from the cited source. User must confirm applicability before an interactive verification. Passing encoded checks does not establish unmodeled performance.
verification_scope: Temperature plus the named indispensable measurement/handling functions; no extrapolation of undocumented performance, pressure, calibration, cleanliness or full facility safety.
